metadata.imputation: per-split forward-linear interpolation (limit=2) then zero-fill; mask created before imputation
metadata.anti_leakage: scaler fit on train only; temporal assertions enforced per fold; no test data used in tuning or lookback selection

Persistence.note: No trainable parameters. No hyperparameter search required.

Wilcoxon_test.description: Pairwise Wilcoxon signed-rank test on macro-average MAE across 2 folds × 5 seeds (10 paired values per model).

Friedman_Nemenyi.description: Friedman rank test across 40 evaluation blocks (2 folds × 5 seeds × 4 lakes = 40 blocks). Nemenyi post-hoc Critical Difference at alpha=0.05 computed using Demsar (2006) q-values.
Friedman_Nemenyi.reference: Demsar J. (2006). Statistical comparisons of classifiers over multiple data sets. JMLR, 7, 1-30.

robustness_test.description: Synthetic missing data injection on test set features only. Model trained on clean data (p_miss=0), evaluated with corrupted inputs.

cross_fold_generalizability.description: Temporal generalizability: ratio of Fold_B MAE to Fold_A MAE. Ratio < 1.10 = excellent, 1.10-1.25 = good, 1.25-1.50 = moderate, >1.50 = poor.

attention_analysis.description: Mean attention weights from iTransformer encoder layers averaged across batch and heads. Indicates relative importance of each variable token.

model_complexity_summary._description: Unified model complexity table. n_params = total trainable parameters. train_time_min = mean across 5 seeds on Fold_A. inference_time_ms = mean over 100 forward passes. n_epochs = mean convergence epoch.
